text.hi: बीते समय के दो काम हों, तो जो पहले हुआ उसमें had + तीसरा रूप: The train had left before I arrived. (ट्रेन पहले जा चुकी थी, मैं बाद में पहुँचा)
text.hinglish: Beete samay ke do kaam hon, to jo pehle hua usmein had + teesra roop: The train had left before I arrived. (Train pehle ja chuki thi, main baad mein pahuncha)
text.en: When two things happened in the past, use had + 3rd form for the one that happened first: The train had left before I arrived.

meaning.hi: डॉक्टर के आने से पहले हैरी मर चुका था।
meaning.hinglish: Doctor ke aane se pehle Harry mar chuka tha.

meaning.hi: तुम्हारे आने से पहले बारिश रुक चुकी थी।
meaning.hinglish: Tumhaare aane se pehle baarish ruk chuki thi.

steps.sentence: I ___ the school before the bell rang. (reach)

meaning.hi: घंटी बजने से पहले मैं स्कूल पहुँच चुका था।
meaning.hinglish: Ghanti bajne se pehle main school pahunch chuka tha.

steps.sentence: There was a storm after the plane ___. (land)

meaning.hi: विमान उतर जाने के बाद तूफ़ान आया।
meaning.hinglish: Vimaan utar jaane ke baad toofaan aaya.

steps.sentence: The thief ___ away before the police came. (run)

meaning.hi: पुलिस के आने से पहले चोर भाग चुका था।
meaning.hinglish: Police ke aane se pehle chor bhaag chuka tha.

steps.question: Which happened first? ‘I had finished my work before you came.’
